protocol.selection: Highest training CAGR minus 0.5 times maximum drawdown; no reselection on test results
protocol.rule: Monthly top two positive trailing-total-return ETFs, half capital each; each weight capped at half capital and annual volatility target; unallocated cash earns zero
limitations: Retrospective research, not a previously deployed strategy
Universe chosen today introduces design hindsight
Six candidate trials on training period; test is not used for parameter choice
2024/2025 market behavior already examined in separate experiments, so not a pristine blind holdout
USD ETF portfolio is not an India-stock or original committee performance claim
